$comment: Failing fidelity cases, replayed on every run by both the text-only properties and P4 (phase-1.md 9.3). Every entry must pass. A case is a function of source, seed, type and, for a generated case, its plan attempt (which pins the plan and the draw whatever the edit API does) or, for a corpus case, its plan; FIDELITY_CASE=<source>:<seed>:<type>[:<plan>|:@<attempt>] replays it. Each entry stores a fingerprint, the intent the case draws, and the run fails loudly when the generator no longer draws it, so an entry cannot drift. `status` and `answer` record what the edit API must answer for a fixed bug. Seeds found on the old API were checked to fail P4 there.

cases.reason: Edit API bug, found by P4 and fixed (dep-anchors.ts): removeAttr start on a task that another task's `precedes` names leaves it without an anchor, so the engine deadlocks (not_scheduled, ok true to false). It is now refused conflicting-attribute. Pinned to its plan attempt, so it replays on the old API too (checked: fails P4 on 5b4dbfb2).

Edit API bug, found by P4 and fixed (dep-anchors.ts): removeAttr start on a task that another task's `precedes` names leaves it without an anchor, so the engine deadlocks (not_scheduled, ok true to false). It is now refused conflicting-attribute. Pinned to its plan attempt, so it replays on the old API too (checked: fails P4 on 5b4dbfb2).

Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a drawn minstart date lay outside the corpus plan's project frame (date_in_range, found by P4). Dates are now drawn inside the frame; this seed draws a minstart on the same plan (the original seed no longer draws it).

Oracle bug in the suite, fixed: a setAttr aimed at a statement written with a macro used a value that failed validation, so it was refused invalid-value instead of text-only. This seed aims at the macro-written effort of a corpus task and must be refused text-only.
Oracle bug in the suite, fixed (found by the nightly, shard 3): the gap of an item written `{ gapduration 1h}` was read as `1h}`; the pattern now stops at a closing brace.

Model bug in the suite, fixed (nightly, shard 3): with no `leaves` list but `vacation` statements after the project header, addLeave inserts a new `leaves` statement right after the header, so the item comes first, not last (calendar-leaves.ts). The expectation counts the items before the insertion place.

Oracle bug in the suite, fixed (nightly, shard 3): Todolist's tasks have automatic ids (`_Task_5`), which the engine renumbers when a task is added, so the hints taken from the golden result name other tasks after the edit (15.24, no text names them). After a task tree intent on a hinted plan only literal ids are compared.
